g.text: LLD 1 · A full run: Run.full, its reports written with it (nayose resolve records … --workspace …)
every step after load reads records
the input: the files given, read as they come (inputs/)
: count every key's pairs before any join; flag blocks too big to join blind
: learn the model from the file itself, without labels; measure u on this file
: join the certain cases, the first rule wins; score each pair with the model; cluster them (they steer the candidates)
Run.rules · Run._rules · Run._untrusted · match.rule_edges · match.score_fs · cluster.merge · source.filled
: list the pairs worth scoring; check big blocks on a sample
Run.candidates · run.listed · candidates.candidates · Run._gate · Run._scored · match.score_fs · Run._gated · Run._joined
: give every candidate pair its evidence in bits, a million at a time, saying how far it is; count the patterns they fall in
Run.score · Run._scored · match.score_fs · Run._patterns · Run._bands · results.banded · match.named_sql · match.review_floor

: merge the rules' and the model's pairs at the trust line (none set: every rule pair, and the model's at its threshold with a name compared), or, with the workspace's merge conditions, the pairs that meet them; people's matches, less their no_match; join them into entities, from single records
Run._load_decisions · Run.cluster · Run._accept · Run.scored · match.named_sql · Run._links · results.merge_where
: the matches no key lists: pairs drawn within groups matches share (a phone, a postal area), scored; those at the line the likely links don't join, counted and scaled
: save the answer, the pairs at 0 points or more with each comparison's level (scored/), the state for increments and the reports (9, built first); the old run goes only once all is written
